analysis_steps.goal: Image ALMA continuum and measure fluxes

method.value: Natural-weighted mfs continuum images; integrated fluxes over regions >1.5 sigma; 3 sigma upper limits over one beam; blended sources deblended with two Gaussians

evidence.quote: Integrated fluxes are determined over regions where the signal has a significance $>$1.5$\sigma$.

analysis_steps.goal: Fit MIR-radio SEDs with three components

method.value: MR-MOOSE Bayesian MCMC fit of AGN power-law with cutoff, modified blackbody for SF dust, and synchrotron power law, with multi-resolution component assignment

evidence.quote: The code fits simultaneously all pre-selected analytic models and uses Bayesian statistics to find the most likely solution given the set of observed fluxes.

key_parameters.value: lambda_cut=33 um fixed; T prior [20,70] K; gamma [0,6]; alpha [-4,0]

assumptions.value: beta=2.5, nu0=1.5 GHz; uniform priors; synchrotron without cutoff (maximum contribution)

evidence.quote: A value of $\beta=2.5$ has been adopted in this paper.

fitting.value: emcee MCMC, chi2 likelihood with upper-limit treatment of Sawicki2012, uniform priors

evidence.quote: it uses Bayesian parameter estimation to find posterior distributions of the free parameters which are determined based on the prior distribution (uniform) and the likelihood function.

validation.value: lambda_cut calibrated on 4C 23.56; comparison with Drouart2014 luminosities

evidence.quote: This value was determined by letting $\lambda_\text{cut}$ be a free parameter for one galaxy and finding the best fit value.

analysis_steps.goal: Integrate IR luminosities and uncertainties; derive SFR

method.value: Integrate models over rest-frame 8-1000 um for each MCMC sample; percentiles give uncertainties; upper limits by scaling modified BB (beta=2.5, T=50 K) to ALMA; SFR from Kennicutt1998 divided by 1.5 for Kroupa

evidence.quote: This is done by scaling a modified BB (with fixed $\beta = 2.5$ and T=$50$ K) to the ALMA data point.
